Additionally, the statute governing officer-and-director bars, 15 U.S.C. § 78u-1, provides that a court may modify or vacate an officer-and-director bar upon a showing of "good cause" or "changed circumstances." The legislative history of this statute, as reflected in the Senate Report accompanying the Securities Exchange Act Amendments of 1990 (S. Rep.
